behavior_change_boundaries.intended_behavior_change: Only plain s1_survival return_action_teacher_mask is suppressed outside CONTRACT/RETURN unless explicit simplified readiness says pre_return_ready or return_now.

corrections.behavior_change: none beyond the already approved gate; thresholds and gating semantics are unchanged.
corrections.code_change: Replaced undefined cfg references with existing module Config thresholds inside Preprocessor.reward_process(), and changed helper parameter type from dict[str, object] | None to collections.abc.Mapping[str, object] | None.
corrections.trigger: Atlas verification found introduced LSP errors: undefined cfg in the new readiness call and invariant dict[str, object] helper type mismatch for evaluate_simplified_return_readiness() result.

implementation_summary.action_value_preserved: return_action_teacher is still copied from teacher guidance before gating and is not modified when the mask is suppressed.
implementation_summary.critical_fallback_preserved: route_phase_action_teacher/source logic is unchanged; critical battery route-phase steps without return_action_reliable/anchor_reliable/target_reliable still fall through to route_phase_teacher_from_critical_fallback.
implementation_summary.preprocessor_change: Added _plain_survival_return_action_teacher_mask_allowed() and applied it only after return_action_teacher_mask is computed/boosted in Preprocessor.reward_process(). For train_phase == s1_survival, the mask stays active only if current_mode is MODE_CONTRACT/MODE_RETURN or evaluate_simplified_return_readiness() reports return_now/pre_return_ready. Post-verification correction uses Config for thresholds in this function and Mapping for the helper readiness type.
implementation_summary.scope_limit: No reward coefficients, PPO algorithm, phase/env/runtime state, Docker compose, simulator, benchmark/scoring, checkpoints, or teacher weight environment variables were changed.

next_action: Ask Oracle before any diagnostic rerun, benchmark, checkpoint promotion, phase/config/runtime change, teacher-weight change, global80 continuation, or F1/original task completion claim.

lsp_diagnostics.remaining_summary: Remaining LSP diagnostics are pre-existing/environment noise: missing numpy import, implicit import policy diagnostics, broad unannotated/unknown typing in preprocessor.py, and dynamic ModuleType/private-test-stub diagnostics in tests.
